shots.p: all of creation glorifying at sunrise
people divided into two crowds, believers and deniers
the earth and sky perfectly fashioned
ruins of a past nation in the desert
a man believing and walking toward light
a vast plain where people gather, mutual loss and gain
a dark land with distant fire
a woman in hijab patiently enduring a calamity
a family whose children distract from good
wealth and children as a test
a man lending a goodly loan
a vast starry sky, majestic and wise
